mocraResponsiblePersonChecklist.statutoryRuleClarification: The cosmetic product label must include a domestic address, domestic phone number, OR electronic contact information (such as a website or monitored email address) through which the Responsible Person can receive adverse event reports. Both a U.S. street address and domestic phone number are not mandatory in every case.
mocraResponsiblePersonChecklist.placeholderPolicy: No invented contact details or unmonitored placeholder addresses may be published.

requiredConfirmations.question: Who legally qualifies as the Responsible Person (manufacturer, packer, or distributor whose name appears on the label under 21 U.S.C. § 364(4)) for each applicable product?
Whose legal business name appears on the physical product packaging/label shipped to consumers?
Which statutory contact method will be used on the label and storefront (domestic address, domestic phone number, OR electronic contact information)?
Is the selected contact method actively monitored and capable of receiving, documenting, and reporting serious adverse events within statutory timelines (15 business days)?
